metadata.scope: Automatic test generation and strengthening infrastructure

generation_engine.py.classification: SCAFFOLDING_OR_PARTIAL - the engine exists but the actual generation pipeline is not fully wired
generation_engine.py.notes: Contains the generation engine class but the end-to-end pipeline is not documented as complete

test_generator.py.notes: Contains test generation logic but the actual generation is not fully wired

strengthening_pipeline.py.notes: Contains the pipeline class but the actual strengthening is not fully wired

c53_scenarios.py.notes: C53 controlled scenarios for test generation

end_to_end_pipeline.survivor_to_diagnosis: VERIFIED - survivor_intel.py builds per-mutant survivor intelligence
end_to_end_pipeline.diagnosis_to_candidate_weakness: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED - candidate_validation.py exists but the full diagnosis pipeline is not documented
end_to_end_pipeline.candidate_weakness_to_generated_test: SCAFFOLDING_ONLY - generation_engine.py and test_generator.py exist but the actual generation is not verified to produce useful tests
end_to_end_pipeline.generated_test_to_execution: UNVERIFIED - no evidence that generated tests are actually executed
end_to_end_pipeline.execution_to_mutant_re_execution: UNVERIFIED - no evidence that mutants are re-executed against generated tests
end_to_end_pipeline.validation_to_regression_check: UNVERIFIED - no evidence of regression check
end_to_end_pipeline.regression_check_to_evidence: UNVERIFIED - no evidence of evidence generation

scope_restrictions.engines_only: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED - the framework was originally designed for engines but the generation_engine.py and test_generator.py may support other layers

human_authorization.boundaries: VERIFIED - AuthorizationLevel enum (NONE, OPERATOR, HUMAN, CI_ONLY) in capability_catalog.py
human_authorization.enforcement: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED - the boundaries are defined but the enforcement is not fully documented

findings.operational: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED - the components exist but the end-to-end pipeline is not verified to operate
findings.partial: VERIFIED - some components work individually (survivor_intel, candidate_validation)
findings.scaffolding: VERIFIED - generation_engine.py and test_generator.py appear to be scaffolding without full implementation
findings.stub: UNVERIFIED - cannot determine if these are stubs without more detailed inspection

conclusion.notes: The automatic test generation infrastructure exists as components (generation_engine.py, test_generator.py, strengthening_pipeline.py) but the end-to-end pipeline (survivor -> diagnosis -> generated test -> execution -> mutant re-execution -> validation -> regression check -> evidence) is NOT verified to operate. The system can at best produce high-value, evidence-driven test recommendations. The system is NOT restricted architecturally to engines, but the actual generation scope is not verified. Human authorization boundaries are defined but not fully enforced.
